title: ATTITUDE Sensitive Skin Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+, Unscented, 2.1 Oz | EWG Verified, Oxybenzone Free, No White Cast, Lightweight, Travel Size, Broad Spectrum UVA/UVB, Fragrance Free - Whole Foods Market
text:
ATTITUDE Sensitive Skin Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+, Unscented, 2.1 Oz | EWG Verified, Oxybenzone Free, No White Cast, Lightweight, Travel Size, Broad Spectrum UVA/UVB, Fragrance Free | Grocery Pickup & Delivery | Whole Foods Market Skip main navigation Home Sign in Account & Orders Cart Grocery Pickup & Delivery Weekly Sales Catering Recipes Shop Aisles Deals Grocery Pickup & Delivery Previous Next ATTITUDE ATTITUDE Sensitive Skin Mineral Sunscreen Stick SPF 50+, Unscented, 2.1 Oz | EWG Verified, Oxybenzone Free, No White Cast, Lightweight, Travel Size, Broad Spectrum UVA/UVB, Fragrance Free
 Select Size : 2.12 Ounce (Pack of 1) 2.12 Ounce (Pack of 1) $24.99 3 Ounce (Pack of 1) $26.99 Add to Cart Description
 100% MINERAL STICK, BROAD SPECTRUM SPF 50+: A mineral sunscreen stick for sensitive skin; 24% non-nano zinc oxide helps prevent sunburn. Swipe on face and body for quick, mess-free coverage that reactive skin can wear at the beach or on the trail.
 EWG VERIFIED, OXYBENZONE & OCTINOXATE FREE: Certified by the Environmental Working Group. No oxybenzone, octinoxate, avobenzone, octocrylene, homosalate or octisalate (Hawaii Act 104 compliant); no parabens, phthalates, PEGs, phenoxyethanol or mineral oil.
 NO WHITE CAST, MESS-FREE: Glides on smoothly in one swipe and blends to an ultra-sheer finish, with no drips and no greasy feel. Zinc oxide 24% with coconut oil, grape seed oil and moisturizing shea butter. Water-free, no preservatives.
 UNSCENTED & FRAGRANCE FREE: No fragrance at all, for anyone who prefers a sunscreen with no added scent and for noses and skin that react to perfumes. Also a good pick for kids and for anyone with fragrance sensitivities.
 VEGAN & DERMATOLOGIST TESTED: 100% vegan, never tested on animals. A 2.1 oz carry-on size stick for the beach bag, backpack or travel kit. Also available as an SPF 30 paper-tube stick. From the sensitive natural sun care range by ATTITUDE.
 Ingredients
 Active ingredient : Zinc oxide 24 % Inactive ingredients : Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Wax, Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Octyldodecanol, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Vitis Vinifera (Grape) Seed Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Maleated Soybean Oil Glyceryl / Octyldodecanol Esters (Soybean/Soja), Glyceryl Behenate, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Oil (Gluten), Tocopherol.
